title: config/release.json
description: The packages, manifests and Go modules that a release tag covers, read by scripts/kit/release.mts.

repositoryUrl.description: The URL of the repository; the notes of a release that is too long link CHANGELOG.md below it.

changelog.description: The change log whose section `## X.Y.Z` is the notes of the release.

changelogTranslations.description: Further change logs that must hold the section `## X.Y.Z`.

checks.description: The check runs of the tagged commit that must have concluded success; push-gate and ci-passed when absent.

packages.description: The packages that a tag vX.Y.Z releases as one archive each; a wheel is released as its PEP 427 wheel.

directory.description: The directory of the package below the root, or . for a package at the root of the repository (kit itself).

generated.description: Artifacts that are generated from the package files of the tagged commit and included in its archive; never written into the checkout.

manifests.description: Each manifest whose version a tag vX.Y.Z sets, with how the tag releases it: archive, version or git-tag.

notReleased.description: Each tracked manifest that no tag releases, with the reason.

goModules.description: Each Go module by its directory (`.` for the repository root) with its module path.

consumers.description: The consumer projects that install the archives of a tag outside the repository (release-consumer.mts); one per package kind that has packages. A wheel has no committed project; its lock is named per package.

directory.description: The directory of the committed manifest and lock of the consumer project.

smoke.description: Each package that the consumer installs, with the command (an array of strings) that checks it in the installed project.

directory.description: The directory of the committed manifest and lock of the consumer project.

smoke.description: Each package that the consumer installs, with the command (an array of strings) that checks it in the installed project.

polyspec.description: The polyspec dependencies of the Composer consumer, each the name of an entry of config/release-assets.json whose release zip (make release-assets-fetch) the artifact repository of the project holds beside the archives of the tag; the counterpart of consumers.wheel.polyspec.

smoke.description: Each wheel package, with the command (an array of strings) that checks it in the installed virtual environment.

lock.description: Each wheel package with the path of its PEP 751 lock (pylock.toml or pylock.<name>.toml): the registry packages and the polyspec archives that the wheel depends on, installed with their hashes. A sibling (another wheel package of this configuration, released by the same tag) is not held here; a Requires-Dist names it by its URL of the release without a hash.

polyspec.description: Each polyspec distribution that a wheel may depend on, with the URL of its GitHub repository; a Requires-Dist names it only by a direct reference to its release asset with a sha256 fragment. A wheel package of this configuration is a sibling and is never declared here.

proof.description: What the release proof (release-proof.mts) installs from the tag besides the archives.

gitTag.description: Each manifest with the mode git-tag, with { kind: rust, name, smoke } for its install from the tag.
